case_studies.title: Naples Dent Away
case_studies.summary: 595 clicks and 9 conversions from a $1,720 Google Ads campaign.
case_studies.detail: Naples Dent Away, a dent repair service in Naples, Florida, ran a digital advertising campaign to boost its online visibility. The campaign generated 595 clicks from 25,000 impressions, resulting in 9 conversions. With a total spend of $1,720, the average cost per click was approximately $2.89. While the click-through rate was strong, the campaign points to clear areas for conversion rate optimisation. The business continues to build brand awareness and connect with local customers through strategic digital marketing.

images.alt: Naples Dent Away ads results dashboard

case_studies.source_note: Figures from the Google Ads dashboard screenshot supplied with the project.
